Chapter 7067: Does That Hurt?

Chapter 7067: Does That Hurt?

Not to mention other immortals, even the four celestial immortals became slack-jawed. They knew how strong their attacks were, certainly capable of sweeping through a thousand regular immortals. Alas, they failed to suppress or injure him.

“Did you see that?” Someone remarked upon seeing Li Qiye’s strange nullification method.

“It’s ridiculous.” An immortal said.

“Ridiculous? He might be able to swallow the high heaven.” A primordial immortal turned pale.

“You can have it back.” Li Qiye smiled at the opponents before shouting: “Wither!”

A beam emanated from his mouth, extinguishing everything by withering them down.

“Watch it!” The four summoned treasures and defenses.

“Rumble!” Heaven’s Demise conjured countless tablets to isolate himself from the outside world.

Heaven’s Slayer turned into a flame. As long as this flame survived, so would he.

Dragongrasp’s body cracked, revealing the affinities making up his true body. This was the toughest force and should be unbreakable.

Zhao Dachui relied on his devouring dao and hid within this dark affinity.

The four utilized their best defense, capable of blocking a move from the high heaven.

“Rumble!” Alas, the withering beam overwhelmed and made them scream in pain. Their body withered like a piece of paper being burned to ashes.

“Would the high heaven wither too?” A spectator asked.

Meanwhile, the four suffered a misery beyond the slash that had killed them. After all, they disintegrated slowly instead of instant death.

On the other hand, they were already dead, so how could they die again?

“Splash!” It didn’t take long before the disintegrated celestial immortals appeared in the ocean again.

“They’re back.” Someone said.

“Still not enough?” Another murmured.

“Since they’re already dead, can’t destroy them.” A golden immortal said.

“Hahaha, as we’ve said, we can’t die.” Zhao Dachui laughed.

“Did that hurt?” Li Qiye asked with a smile.

The four’s expression darkened. Although they couldn’t be destroyed, the pain was real.

“I can repeat this a billion times over.” Li Qiye said.

“Not if we kill you here and now.” Heaven’s Demise said.

“Kill me? With what? I merely returned your powers to you just now, don’t think you can’t be defeated.” Li Qiye said.

Listeners took a deep breath. Li Qiye had swallowed their powers and sent them back. That wasn’t his own power.
